nodes.title: Payment status from the business's gateway: Razorpay, Cashfree and PayU webhooks, each verified with the gateway's own scheme, matched to one contact by a named record key, giving campaigns' dial gate paidSinceImport() and, optionally, a verified outcome on the person's recent call
nodes.details:
Route POST /hooks/payments/:integrationId (migration 0110: intake_payment_source, contact_payment).
- Razorpay: X-Razorpay-Signature is a hex HMAC-SHA256 of the raw body; events payment.captured, order.paid, payment_link.paid.
- Cashfree: x-webhook-signature is a Base64 HMAC-SHA256 of timestamp + body, within a 5-minute window; event PAYMENT_SUCCESS.
- PayU: form POST with the reverse SHA-512 hash (with and without additional_charges).
Each payment is kept once per gateway payment id. Unmatched and ambiguous payments are deleted after 30 days. Tools source.payments.setup and source.payments.list; web Contacts > Import > Payments. Tests: intake-payments 5/5 with doc-shaped fixtures signed using generated secrets; e2e flow 86/86 with the razorpay kind added locally (it skips until workspace adds the kind). Not verified: a real gateway delivery.

nodes.title: A payment matches a person only by a record key the workspace names (policy, loan or order id kept as a contact detail), exactly one live contact or none; never by the payer's phone
nodes.rationale: Razorpay's own payment_link.paid sample shows the payer's contact differing from the link's customer. A relative or employer often pays. Matching by phone would stop calls to the wrong person, or miss the right one. Two people sharing a reference is 'ambiguous' and acts on no one.
nodes.reverse_if: Buyers routinely cannot pass a record key to their gateway; then add phone matching as an explicit, per-source opt-in with its own test.

nodes.title: The dial gate's 'already paid' counts a payment unless the person's record of that key was observed more than 24 hours after it. A list exported before someone paid but imported after still does not call them.
nodes.rationale: Measured in intake-payments: with a strict 'paid after the last import' rule, a list without its own 'Updated at' (observed_at is the import time) reopened a person who had paid minutes before the import. Calling someone who paid is the harm this feature exists to prevent; skipping a genuinely new due date for up to a day is the lesser one.
nodes.reverse_if: Daily-cycle collections (a new due every day) show the margin skips real dues; then make the margin per source.

nodes.title: The sample pack's 'Add me' test row copying the first person's facts
nodes.tried: The member's test row took row 0's facts (policy number, loan, order) so the call had something to say.
nodes.broke: In the payments e2e flow, a Razorpay payment for Aarti's policy SH-2026-40110 matched two contacts (Aarti and the member's test contact) and became 'ambiguous': the gate would have called her after she paid. The test row now gets its own record ids (samples.ts testFacts), and intake-samples asserts they are unique for the id-keyed packs.

nodes.title:
Payment webhooks: 5/5 server tests and 1 browser flow.
- Refused: forged or altered bodies for each gateway, a Cashfree timestamp 10 minutes old, another PayU merchant key, an unset source (409), an unknown id (404).
- Matched: by reference_id, notes, order_tags and udf1.
- Ambiguous and unmatched act on no one.
- Duplicates are no-ops.
- A verified outcome is recorded once on a call within 14 days and not for a call 20 days old.
- paidSinceImport is scoped to the workspace, holds through a record only hours newer, and reopens after a record more than a day newer.
nodes.n: 5 server tests (3 gateways, 13 refusal or no-op cases); e2e 86/86
nodes.method: node:test on a fresh Postgres over real HTTP (tests/intake-payments.test.ts), fixtures shaped from the providers' documented samples and signed with generated secrets; Playwright via e2e/run.sh
nodes.not_verified: A real Razorpay, Cashfree or PayU delivery; the gate's use of paidSinceImport (campaigns wires G4); PayU's split-payment hash (refused, not accepted).

nodes.title: Payment status is inert until workspace adds the razorpay, cashfree and payu integration kinds (agreed), and campaigns wires paidSinceImport into G4 as 'already_paid' for campaign, api and retry attempts (agreed)
nodes.closes_when: Both land, and the payments e2e flow runs instead of skipping, plus a campaigns test shows G4 refusing a paid person.

events.details: Payment webhooks (Razorpay, Cashfree, PayU) built in intake, read only, from the providers' own docs; paidSinceImport for campaigns' G4. A sample-pack bug found by the new e2e flow (the test row shared the first person's policy number) was fixed. Verified: tsc clean; intake-payments 5/5; intake-samples 3/3; e2e 86/86 with the kind added locally. Not verified: real gateway deliveries.
